decisions.name: Pulltite Campground / Current River landing
decisions.rationale: NPS lists Pulltite among the popular Upper Current River put-ins and documents the Pulltite-to-Round-Spring float. Current Google Maps aerial imagery shows the County Road EE-356 campground approach reaching the Current River at the selected point. The old coordinate was a practical campground-area anchor, about 403 feet from mapped water and 485 feet from the matched flowline. The updated point is on mapped water and 66 feet from the named flowline; it is an imagery estimate and not surveyed by NPS.

postCorrectionAudit.waterProximity: within-100ft for all 3; mapped-water distance 0 ft

decisions.reopenWhen: Recheck if NPS relocates or closes the Pulltite landing, or publishes a surveyed coordinate.
